judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the test-writing phase and never modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`, meaning `afterModelResponse` still only reports `lastUsage` and the candidate's own new acceptance tests in `chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts` fail. It also omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` entry and the `OrchestratorHooks` signature update (`totalUsage?: UsageMetadata`). While the candidate did update `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and write valid test cases covering the multi-round sum and partial-round reporting criteria, it left the updated spec bullet inside the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section instead of moving it into the active specification, placed tests in a separate file rather than `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and left behind `.lore/dod.md`.
